recap.text: Carl tells Maggie, the lava rock crawler hiding in the sand, about the Phase Lava Rock potion Mordecai made from the sponsor-box yam. When Chris erupts beside the winding box, Carl slams the potion, reaches through the rock into his head, and pulls out a palm-sized worm. It bites his palm and burrows into his arm, so he drinks the double-healing potion, and the worm bursts from his neck into Mongo's grasp.

beats.headline: One minute through rock
beats.text: With under an hour to collapse and the saferooms closed, Carl calls to the camouflaged lava rock crawler hiding somewhere in the sand: he knows Maggie is in there. They told her about the potion, she answers from under the dune. He explains the yam from the sponsor box, which Mordecai worked out with Samantha's help, and what Mordecai made from it, a Phase Lava Rock potion. Once he takes it, Chris's arms will go right through him. It only lasts a minute, so he edges along the sand toward the winding box and waits. They only need to move it five feet.
beats.gist: Carl tells hidden Maggie that Mordecai's potion will let Chris's arms pass through him for one minute.

beats.headline: A hand into Chris's head
beats.text: Chris erupts from the ground beside the winding box. Carl slams the phase potion and rushes him as he hurls the box away, its two watches flying in different directions. Carl reaches into Chris's head, through the rock, to the one solid thing in it, a palm-sized worm lodged in his brain, and pulls. It bites his palm and burrows into his arm. He waits out the last two seconds of his potion countdown and drinks the double-healing potion that cured his parasites on the third floor. The worm bursts out of his neck, and Mongo grabs it.
beats.gist: Carl yanks the worm from Chris's brain, then a potion forces it out of him.

relations.note: Maggie, the worm in Chris's brain
